title: 🚨Semi Final ROAST😂 Jacob Bethell 105 Bumrah IND vs ENG India Into the Finals T20 World Cup 2026
description:
🚨Semi Final ROAST😂 Jacob Bethell 105 Bumrah IND vs ENG India Into the Finals T20 World Cup 2026
India have repeated history in this semifinal – England were sent packing once again, just like “the English had to leave India” in the old days. Jacob Bethell smashed a brilliant century, and almost took England over the line, but Jasprit Bumrah stopped him and Hardik Pandya ran him out, so ultimately it was MI blood that had to stop RCB blood!

Now India have reached the final – but this match also left Gautam Gambhir very annoyed, because in almost every way, the numbers came out the same on both sides:

India lost 7 wickets; so did England.

Sanju Samson hit 7 sixes; Bethell also hit 7 sixes.

India won by exactly 7 runs.

And Thala (Dhoni) was there to take the credit in the end, because of how evenly balanced the match looked on paper.

So even though India won, the eerie symmetry in the scoreline and the performances is what’s really making people talk!
